tools.name: dynamics365_whoami
tools.description: Return the user id, business unit id and organization id that the app user acts as in this environment. Good first call to confirm the connection. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/WhoAmI.

tools.name: dynamics365_list_tables
tools.description: List Dataverse tables (entity definitions) with their logical name, entity set name and whether they are custom. Use the entity set name in the record tools. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/EntityDefinitions.

tools.name: dynamics365_get_table_columns
tools.description: List the columns (attributes) of one table: logical name, schema name, type, and whether it is the primary id or primary name. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='<table>')/Attributes.

tools.name: dynamics365_list_records
tools.description: List rows of one entity set with optional column selection, OData $filter, $orderby and $top. If the reply has @odata.nextLink, pass that value as next_link to get the next page (the other options are then ignored). Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>.

tools.name: dynamics365_get_record
tools.description: Return one record by id, with optional column selection. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>(<id>).

tools.name: dynamics365_run_fetchxml
tools.description: Run a FetchXML query for complex joins, aggregates and link-entities. The root <entity name> is the table logical name. Keep the query under about 4000 characters. Dataverse Web API: GET /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>?fetchXml=...

tools.name: dynamics365_create_record
tools.description: Create one record in an entity set and return the created row. Writes data in the customer's environment. Dataverse Web API: POST /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set> with Prefer: return=representation.

tools.name: dynamics365_update_record
tools.description: Update the given columns of one existing record. It never creates a record: the request sends If-Match: *, so an unknown id returns an error. Writes data in the customer's environment. Dataverse Web API: PATCH /api/data/v9.2/<entity_set>(<id>).
